YouTube Thumbnail Maker

Design YouTube thumbnails at 1280×720: background style, bold headline text and accent colors, with a live preview and PNG download.

YouTube Thumbnail Maker

1280×720 thumbnails — bold text, accent styles, PNG download.

Live preview

📖 How to use

  1. Type your headline and optional subtext.
  2. Pick a background style and accent color.
  3. Adjust text size and position.
  4. Preview live, then click "Download PNG".

❓ Frequently asked questions

What size is the thumbnail?

The thumbnail renders at 1280×720 pixels — YouTube's recommended thumbnail size.

How do I make the text readable?

Keep the headline under ~6 words and large — the auto-fit keeps it readable even at small preview sizes.

Is there a background for face-cam thumbnails?

Yes — the dark backdrop option is designed to sit behind profile photos or game screenshots.
